RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, November 25, 2010/Agrahayana 4, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries; Prime Minister; Atomic Energy;Communications and Information
Technology; Culture; Earth Sciences; External Affairs; Housing and Urban
Poverty Alleviation; Overseas Indian Affairs; Parliamentary Affairs;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science and
Technology; Social  Justice and Empowerment; Space; Tourism;
Urban Development; Water Resources;
Youth Affairs and  Sports)
Total number of questions—20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Committee to enquire IPL scam
†*221. SHRI BALAV ANT ALIAS
BAL APTE: Will the Minister of YOUTH
AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government/Board of
Control for Cricket in India has set up a
Committee for inquiry of Indian Premier
League (IPL) scam;
(b) if so, the names of  the members of
above said Committee;
(c) whether the said Committee has
submitted its report to Government;
(d) if so, the details of recommendations
made by the Committee; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor and the
time by when the report is likely to be
received by Government?
Racial attacks on Indians
†*222. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of OVERSEAS INDIAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of racial attacks on Indians have  increased
abroad in recent past;
(b) if so, the details thereof country-
wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that recently
Australian police has made racial comments
against Indians;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether recently Government has
come across any such incident wherein racial
attacks have been made against Indians in
Britain; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?

69
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Pakistan's Judicial Commission
*223. SHRI ISHWAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Pakistan has proposed to
send its Judicial Commission to India to
verify the proceedings of the Indian
Judiciary on the trial of the lone accused
captured during the 26 November Mumbai
terror attacks;
(b) whether India has sought
clarifications on the constitution of the
commission and its composition and also
the nature, scope and  modus operandi of
its work during Indian visit;
(c) whether India has also made it clear
that no cross examination of the judicial or
investigating officers by the Commission
would take place; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Funds to States for development of
sports
†*224. SHRI ASHK ALI TAK: Will
the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the amount provided to the State
Governments by the Central Government
for development of sports during the last
five years, sport-wise; and
(b) the amount provided for
construction of stadia in the State of
Rajasthan during the last five years,
location-wise?
Stoppage of new connection of MTNL
in Mumbai
†*225. SHRI Y .P . TRIVEDI: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS  AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether process of giving new
connections by MTNL in Mumbai has
been stopped since 24 September, 2010;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) if not, the number of connections
booked between 24 September, 2010 and
30 October, 2010;
(d) the reason for new customers being
denied new Garuda telephone and Dolphin
booking when they went to QSS for
booking;
(e) whether MTNL is not booking new
connections to give benefits to private
service providers; and
(f)  if so, the details thereof?
Norms adopted for identification of
backward States
*226. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) the norms adopted for identification
of backward and tribal districts in the
country and districts identified as per the
norms, State-wise;
(b) the schemes being implemented for
development of the districts identified as
backward and tribal prone, particularly in
Sabarkantha, Amreli and Patan, and
achievements made as a result thereof;
(c) whether Government has undertaken
any review in this regard;
(d) if so, the details and outcome thereof;
and
(e) the corrective measures taken by
Government thereto?

70
E-auctioning of coal blocks
*227. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Planning
Commission is re-thinking on e-auctioning
of coal blocks; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Universal Service Obligation Fund
*228. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the total amount at the disposal of
Universal Service Obligation (USO) Fund
at persent;
(b) the condition for grant of the same;
and
(c) the amount paid to each telecom
companies from USO Fund in 2009-10?
New BSNL landline and mobile
connections
*229. DR. GY AN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY  be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of new BSNL landline
and  mobile  connections  issued  to
consumers in India during the last five
years, year-wise;
(b) the number of landline and mobile
connections of BSNL surrendered during
that period, year-wise, percentage of
surrender;
(c) the above statistics for Rajasthan
Telecom Circle;
(d) the reasons for surrender;
(e) the reasons for customers getting
disenchanted by BSNL;
(f) the corrective action taken thereon;
and
(g) whether services of BSNL are poor,
particularly in rural areas?
F1 Grand Prix in India
*230. SHRI V .P . SINGH BADNORE:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) when and where the Formula-1
Grand Prix is slated to take place in India;
and
(b) the  involvement  of  Sports
Authority of India and Government in this
prestigious event?
Gap between the States and regions
*231. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether some of the States are
lagging behind in development and some
States are developing rapidly, thereby
creating a wide gap between the States and
regions;
(b) if so, the schemes Government is
implementing to bring backward States at
par with advanced States;
(c) to what extent the Backward Regions
Grant Fund (BRGF), etc., are helping to
improve the status of less developed States;
and
(d) the details of social indicators in
which some of the States are lagging behind
and the steps  Ministry is planning to take
to improve their position in coordination
with nodal Ministries?

71
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Protection and repair of canals
*232. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of W A TER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
representations from various State
Governments recently for the protection
and repair of canals which cause heavy
floods almost every year;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard so far?
Demand and supply of uranium
*233. SHRI ANIL MADHAV DAVE:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the gap between the demand and
supply of uranium for reactors; and
(b) in what way Government proposes
to fill this gap?
Substandard concrete in Government
buildings
†*234. SHRI KAPTAN SINGH
SOLANKI: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that construction
companies are using substandard concrete
in Government buildings or bridges being
constructed all over the country;
(b) whether all agencies have been
warned in this regard by the Chief Technical
Examiner of CVC;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether any person has been made
accountable by Government in this regard?
Workers in Gulf countries
*235. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of OVERSEAS INDIAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any data
regarding Indians working in Gulf countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government has any plans
to provide welfare mechanism to the
returnees from Gulf countries?
Emergency Feeding Programme for
APL in Orissa
*236. SHRI RUDRA NARAY AN
PANY: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to extend the Emergency Feeding
Programme (EFP) to cover the Above
Poverty Line (APL) beneficiaries in the
eight KBK districts in Orissa;
(b) whether there is any plan for the
inclusion of six more tribal dominated
districts of the State, namely Sundargarh,
Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar, Kandhamal, Boudh
and Gajapati in this programme;
(c) whether there is a proposal pending
under active consideration for the
enhancement of the ration cost from
` 5.5 to ` 10 per day; and
(d) whether the State Government has
sent any proposal  or request in this regard
to the Centre?
Funds to protect traditional languages
of minorities
*237. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is releasing

72
funds to  protect the traditional languages
of minorities in Andhra Pradesh and other
States;
(b) if so, the details of funds released in
the Eleventh Five Year Plan to each State,
especially for minority regions where many
languages are being spoken; and
(c) the action plan prepared to protect
such languages for future generation by
allocating sufficient funds to each State and
to each language in our country especially
in the Eleventh and Twelfth Five Year Plans?
Departmental employees working
under Superintendent of Posts,
Chhindwara
†*238. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of departmental
employees working under the jurisdiction
of Superintendent of Posts, Chhindwara,
Madhya Pradesh, category-wise;
(b) the number of employees against
whom departmental inquiry under CCS
Rules was proposed during the last three
years;
(c) the penalties imposed after the
departmental inquiry; and
(d) the percentage of employees found
guilty after departmental inquiry?
Diversion of funds by Nehru
Memorial Museum and Library
*239. SHRI PRAKASH JAV ADEKAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Nehru
Memorial Museum and Library has
diverted its funds to any private trust;
(b) the details thereof and the reasons
therefor;
(c) whether there is any audit objection
to this diversion; and
(d) the position Government has taken
in this regard?
Exchange of enclaves
*240. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of enclaves yet to be
exchanged at Indo-Bangladesh border; and
(b) the actions being taken to exchange
the enclaves in accordance with Indira-
Mujib treaty?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 19th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Kartika 28, 1932 (Saka)
